note: Provenance of the DocAssay controlled vocabularies. For each table: source, inclusion rule, status. status=external - an external authoritative source (T0 registry / T1 closed linguistic class / T2 external corpus); calibration - calibrated against audits (frozen, dated). Methodology: an internal provenance note (not shipped); composition and mechanics: an internal composition note (not shipped); source map: an internal source map (not shipped). Update 2026-09-06: verb pools moved to WordNet lemmas + a morphological expander (the internal vocabulary build script (not shipped)), time_words += until (minimal-change gate, decision-record). Update 2026-09-07 (WS1-WS6): host_tlds = full IANA; copula/negation - full classes; exist/generative - attested in a T2 construction; versionless DEPENDENCY negation -> NEI. Update 2026-09-07 (WS4): skipped_dirs = full union of all 163 gitignore patterns minus 61 documented exclusions (verdict-inert gate). Update 2026-09-07 (WS5): file_extensions = registry intersected with T2 attestation (>=2 READMEs) + exemplary fix e\.g(?=\.); 0 new false REFUTED. Update 2026-09-07 (WS7): ci_names 12->14 (+cirrus/codebuild), sync _UNAMBIGUOUS_CI (travis ci), mulanpsl/procfile keep-with-citation - all verdict-inert. Update 2026-09-08: markers.historical_verb_forms = 16 (past copula was|were x change-of-state participle class; -2 false REFUTED on train, 0 true lost, minimal-change gate). Update 2026-09-08: en_prose_words removed from pipeline.json - the language gate was replaced from a 16 function-word counter with a diacritic layer (Latin European language characters, threshold 4; decision-record 2026-09-08_language_gate_diacritics); the non-Latin-script filter script is kept. Update 2026-09-14 (Phase 5/6, ): 3 pools were moved from code into data and registered - project.third_party_license_cues (calibration), project.license_header_patterns (external), structure.license_non_project_dirs (external); added the code_pools section (verdict-shaping pools in code, previously missing as a class). frozen_sha256_prefix updated (dependency/markers were out of sync with Phases 1/4).

names.source: PyPI top-2000 distributions by 30-day downloads (hugovk/top-pypi-packages, dated 2026-09-05, snapshot committed) + toolchain stratum (python, from requires-python) + documented alias surfaces (pytorch/sklearn/k8s)
names.rule: single external source: top-2000 canonical distribution names + spelling variants (hyphen/underscore) + TOOLCHAIN_NAMES + ALIAS_TO_CANONICAL surfaces. Canonical name = PyPI distribution name. Regenerable: the internal vocabulary build script (not shipped) --top 2000 --check

synonyms.source: manual surface map (doc spelling -> canonical PyPI distribution name)
synonyms.rule: surface->canonical pairs: pytorch->torch, sklearn->scikit-learn, k8s->kubernetes; canonical = PyPI distribution name

version_ranges.source: PyPI /pypi/<name>/json latest version per name, snapshot date 2026-09-05 (cache committed); fixed ranges for the python toolchain
version_ranges.rule: [0, latest_major+1) with margin; FIXED_VERSION_RANGES for python; unresolvable names fall back to runtime default (0, 100)

past_time.rule: temporal markers that make a version mention historical

historical_phrases.rule: phrases indicating past state; frozen, date recorded

test_env_patterns.source: lemmas {test, benchmark} (empirical-evaluation verbs) + closed preposition heads {with,on,under,using,against,in,at}; morphological expander (the internal vocabulary build script (not shipped))
test_env_patterns.rule: participle/gerund forms of test + all benchmark forms + tested+PP-head raw-regex

feature_phrases.rule: feature-gate phrases for conditional version bounds

requirement_verb_extra.source: WordNet functioning/compatibility verb classes {run, work} + {compat, compatibility, compatible}; morphological expander (the internal vocabulary build script (not shipped))

compatibility_phrases.source: E6 real-repo precision audit (2026-10-20): migration/upgrade/compatibility framing + release-history locators
compatibility_phrases.rule: a versioned mention in migration/compatibility prose is a non-requirement mention (CLAIM_GATE), never REFUTED

negation_words.rule: full CGEL clausal-negation class incl. pro-forms (none, nobody, nothing, nowhere, no one); verdict-inert (WS3 2026-09-07)

exclusion_words.rule: words that qualify a referent without negating

time_words.source: TimeML/ISO-TimeML temporal signals + discontinuation markers; +until adopted 2026-09-06 (minimal-change gate, decision-record)
time_words.rule: temporal signals ∪ discontinuation markers; must cover past_time ∪ historical_time

historical_verb_forms.source: past copula (be paradigm, T1) × change-of-state participle class (WordNet/VerbNet, golden spec §1.5); regenerator the internal vocabulary build script (not shipped)
historical_verb_forms.rule: was|were + change-state participle constructions marking a past/ceased state (downgrade REFUTED→NEI); freeze-guarded by test_historical_verb_forms_match_past_copula_class; +dropped (N3, 2026-09-13); −2 false REFUTED (pandas pandas.io.wb, pandas.read_gbq), 0 true REFUTED lost (minimal-change gate, 2026-09-08)

exist_verbs.rule: 15 lemmas + morphological expander; lemmas attested in the negated construction of T2 corpus (does not support/need/...); provide added on attestation
exist_verbs.source: WordNet verb classes + T2 construction attestation (2026-09-07, WS6)

copula.rule: full be+do paradigm (13 forms; doth archaic excluded)

ordinal_context.rule: nouns whose following number is not a version (Phase 3, test 12)

generative_verbs.rule: 24 lemmas + expander; lemmas attested in instructional context of T2 corpus (imperative/near-backtick); import/build/start added (verified -28 false REFUTED)

exemplary_phrases.rule: e.g./such as/for example markers (raw regex); e\.g(?=\.) lookahead fix 2026-09-07 (WS5): old e\.g\. never matched (-13 false REFUTED)

file_extensions.source: GitHub Linguist ∪ IANA media types ∪ {.conf,.lock} ∩ external T2 corpus attestation (backtick file-references, ≥2 READMEs; snapshot the pinned corpus snapshot (not shipped))
file_extensions.rule: registry extension attested in a file reference of the external corpus (doc-frequency ≥2) — additive over the current composition; .xml rejected by gate (3 false REFUTED, WS5 2026-09-07)

user_config_files.rule: config files not part of the repo tree

build_artifact_dirs.rule: generated output dirs are not findings

deploy_artifact_files.rule: deploy output files are not findings

git_ref_leading.rule: git ref tokens are not project paths

python_builtins.rule: bare builtin mentions are not project symbols

host_tlds.source: IANA root zone tlds-alpha-by-domain.txt, dated snapshot 2026-09-06 (the pinned IANA snapshot (not shipped)); alnum TLDs, IDN xn-- excluded
host_tlds.rule: full IANA root zone (T0). Used at MATCH time: a qualified SYMBOL claim whose last segment is a TLD abstains only if it does not resolve in the inventory; DEPENDENCY URL spans and structure external-host rejection require unambiguous URL shapes

skipped_dirs.source: github/gitignore union of all 163 templates (snapshot the pinned gitignore snapshot (not shipped), 2026-09-07) ∪ git internal ∪ tool-doc overlay (pip/setuptools); MINUS 61 documented exclusions (real source/content dirs in the eval corpus + documented code-roots, gate-verified)
skipped_dirs.rule: full union of ignored directory names (exhaustive by construction, lowercased) minus names that are real source dirs / documented code-roots (src, libs, internal, docs, test, ...) — verdict-inert on train + held-out (minimal-change gate 2026-09-07, WS4)

manifest_non_code_dirs.rule: dirs not part of the code inventory

license_non_project_dirs.source: vendored/build dirs whose LICENSE is not the project's: projection of manifest_non_code_dirs ∪ skipped_dirs (both external) for the shared entries, plus build/vendor conventions — Cargo workspaces 'crates'/'target' (The Cargo Book, workspaces + target-dir) and the generic 'vendored'/'dist'/'_build'
license_non_project_dirs.rule: a LICENSE under any path segment in this set does not contribute to the project license inventory

reader_file_names.source: reader-project tool configs/manifests (Cargo.toml, package.json, pytest.ini, uv.lock, ...)
reader_file_names.rule: a bare mention of a reader-project config that is absent from the tree is not a stale-repo-path finding; corpus-specific tutorial placeholders (fib_wrapper, myproject, ...) removed 2026-09-15

external_software_files.source: third-party software artifacts referenced by name (C headers, web-server configs)
external_software_files.rule: a bare mention of an external software file that is absent from the tree is not a stale-repo-path finding; corpus-specific artifacts (numpy.pxd, newhooks.py, ...) removed 2026-09-15

excluded_doc_stems.source: historical-doc genres (changelog, changes, commits, release-notes, migration)

excluded_doc_path_markers.source: migration/upgrade guide path phrases (E6 real-repo precision audit, 2026-10-20)
excluded_doc_path_markers.rule: path substrings excluded from claim extraction: a migrate-from-X-to-Y or upgrade guide is historical genre, not a current requirement

license_names.source: SPDX license identifier families (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-3.0, ...)
license_names.rule: closed anchor allowlist for the LICENSE predicate, inside a license-context window

license_context_words.source: English license-usage words (license, licence, licensed, licensing, copyright)
license_context_words.rule: context gate for LICENSE anchors; also skips 'License Version 2.0' in the VERSION scan

license_fold.rule: clause variants fold to the bare form (bsd-3-clause -> bsd) to avoid false REFUTED

versioned_license_bases.source: license families whose version folds into the canonical form (gpl-3.0, apache-2.0)

ci_names.source: documented CI-product set (official product docs; source map §5) — Cirrus CI + AWS CodeBuild added 2026-09-07 (WS7), they were in the source map but missing from the JSON
ci_names.rule: documented CI product names; single-word products need a CI-context word (_UNAMBIGUOUS_CI gates multi-word only); verdict-inert (gate 2026-09-07)

ci_context_words.source: English CI-context nouns (workflow, pipeline, build, badge, runner, ...)

ci_config_files.rule: CI evidence inventory: files whose basename is a known CI config

ci_config_dirs.rule: CI evidence inventory: any *.yml/*.yaml under these directories

third_party_license_cues.rule: license claim whose window carries an attribution cue is not a project claim (REFUTED -> NEI); minimal-change gate on the 17-repo corpus (0 true REFUTED lost, L1 closed, 2026-09-13)

license_header_patterns.source: canonical full-text license headers/bodies: GNU GPLv3 §0, GNU LGPL, GNU AGPL, MPL 2.0, SPDX MIT/BSD templates (dated standard texts)
license_header_patterns.rule: regex projection of the standard texts; a LICENSE-file body is detected as the license it is. [pattern, canonical base] pairs

code_pools.note: Verdict-shaping pools embedded in code (not data/*.json). Registered so the provenance claim covers them as a class.

genre_plan_markers.rule: a REFUTED grounded only in such a document is downgraded to NEI

reader_space_cues.source: English reader-address cues (your/Let's say/Here's/will be saved to)
reader_space_cues.rule: a would-be REFUTED path in a reader-space window is downgraded to NEI

non_english_diacritics.rule: document language gate (ratio > 0.008 over lowercase letters, capitalized words ignored)

lock_source_types.rule: lock evidence refines a version but never closes presence or extends anchors

spdx_operators.rule: a manifest license expression splits into its component licenses

python_context_re.source: Python-version narrative context forms (on/in/under/up to/a Python, supports/drops/represents the Python)
python_context_re.rule: a python version in language-context prose is not a project requirement (CLAIM_GATE)

install_instruction_re.source: install directives (pip/conda install, poetry/uv add, pipx, pyenv)
install_instruction_re.rule: an install instruction is a reader directive, not a manifest claim

config_fragment_re.source: TOML/pyproject assignment and quoted PEP 508 literal shapes
config_fragment_re.rule: a configuration fragment is a reader-authored example, not a claim

generated_mention_re.source: generated-output prose (generated by / to generate / will generate / the generated)
generated_mention_re.rule: a path mention in a generation window is a produced artifact (CLAIM_GATE)

generated_module_c_re.rule: a wrapper output is not a hand-written source file; pattern-based, not a per-project list

dot_fragment_re.rule: a fragment filename pattern is not a concrete file (CLAIM_GATE)

entry_point_re.rule: a distribution-metadata key is not a project code symbol (NEI)

rst_anchor_re.rule: a documentation label is not a project code symbol (NEI)

placeholder_extras.rule: a placeholder path segment is not a concrete repository path

extra_tool_dot_dirs.source: VCS runtime dot dirs .bzr/.hg (not covered by gitignore-derived skipped_dirs)
extra_tool_dot_dirs.rule: runtime/tooling hidden dirs are not stale repo paths
